verdict.rationale: Ramp has a documented Developer API with OAuth scopes and a 174-path OpenAPI spec. Accounting data is clearly exposed programmatically: the CLI has an `accounting` resource, the agent guide lists loading accounting and tracking categories, the MCP server advertises accounting:read and accounting:write scopes, and a banking endpoint returns transactions syncable to an accounting provider. However, the pack never documents the dedicated accounting endpoints themselves (GL accounts, coding, sync status) or what management operations they support. Missing for 10: explicit accounting API endpoint documentation, documented write/manage operations on accounting entities (GL accounts, categories, sync), independent or hands-on corroboration.
